_comment: Runnable (system-1) conformance spec for ai-context-pack, projected from .spire/clusters/tech/contracts/ai-context-pack/INTERFACE_CONTRACT.md '## Conformance spec' into the flat schema interface_conformance.py executes ({method,path,path_params,query,required}). Standalone convention (mirrors dealer-flow-projection / byo-ai-key / ai-rec-backtest-orders). The feature's ONLY wire delta is the additive nested field market_state.market_context: the KEY is ALWAYS emitted on a post-feature backend, but its VALUE (and all four children + every leaf) is OPTIONAL/NULLABLE by design (warm-up/eligibility floors, best-effort isolation) — so the key is asserted as object|null (a null cycle PASSES) and NO child/leaf path is required (asserting one would FAIL a legitimately-null best-effort cycle). The rest is the REGRESSION FLOOR the [additive-keeps-score-byte-identical] invariant demands: the pack must not perturb the score/tier/gate/fingerprint path and market_state must stay the same envelope shape. The five-level null family (per-label / per-horizon / per-sub-component / per-read / whole-pack), byte-identity with-vs-without the pack AND under the 60d->400d daily-bars fetch extension (AC-22/AC-23), warm-up-floor honesty (AC-14), export ride-along + null honesty (AC-19/AC-20), SSE byte-unchanged (AC-11), prompt-template zero-diff (AC-21), glossary presence (AC-25), and the operator span (AC-26) are verified off-harness by the BE runtime proofs + the FE test matrix. Uses SPY (a liquid ticker; fetch once before running, e.g. curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/ticker/SPY). Owner gate (2026-10-26, DESIGN.md Amendments): the endpoints marked _owner_gate read licence-derived data and answer the owner's account alone, so they are marked auth and this spec runs with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session. A --auth-signup user is not an owner and gets 403 owner_only; the refusals are asserted in public-surface.json (signed out) and auth-gated.json (signed in, not the owner).

endpoints._owner_gate: Owner gate (2026-10-26): owner only, since this read carries data computed from the licensed options feed. Run with --auth-cookie of an OWNER_EMAILS session; signed out is 403 auth_required (public-surface.json) and a signed-up non-owner is 403 owner_only (auth-gated.json).
